title: Indexed Fourier coefficient
statement: For a finite index set $\iota$, a function $f:\{−1,1\}^{\iota}\to\mathbb R$, and a finite subset $S\subseteq\iota$, the indexed Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is the uniform average over sign assignments $x$ of $f(x)$ times the product of the signs $x_i$ for $i\in S$.
